Hwei

the Visionary
Mid laneBot lane

Hwei bot is a lane bully who replaces the marksman with long-range spell poke. With a strong engage support, his crowd control makes the 2v2 deadly; later, his range and wave clear let him siege towers from far away. Pick him when you want a bot carry who controls fights instead of auto-attacking.

When to pick Hwei

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Better as a counter-pick against immobile marksmen, and only with an engage support.

Pick into

  • Immobile marksmen like Aphelios, Caitlyn and Draven
  • Lanes where your support has strong engage
  • Enemy bot duos that stand close together

Avoid into

  • Spell-blocking marksmen like Sivir
  • Divers who reach you, like Kai'Sa
  • Teams that need a marksman to take towers late

Great teammates

LeonaHard engage that sets up every spell.
AlistarCombo engage that makes your ultimate easy to land.
NamiPoke and slows that help you land spells.

Your team needs: An engage support and a team that doesn't rely only on your damage to take towers.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Out-ranges almost every marksman with Severing Bolt and Devastating Fire
  • Grim Visage and Gaze of the Abyss set up easy kills for your support
  • Fast wave clear lets your duo take turret plates and move first to dragon
  • Teleport lets you return to lane or join fights anywhere

Weaknesses

  • No dash: engage supports and divers can lock you down
  • Weaker than marksmen at killing towers late without poke first
  • Hard to play: wrong sub-spell choice in a 2v2 loses the lane
  • Burst-heavy teams can kill you before you cast

Power spikes

  • Level 2-3: with your support's engage, your crowd control makes all-ins deadly
  • Level 6: Spiraling Despair can kill both enemies in a 2v2
  • First item (Blackfire Torch): constant poke damage
  • Two items (Liandry's Torment): long fights and tanky supports melt
  • Three items (Shadowflame): your bolts finish marksmen

Top tips

  • Pair Hwei with engage supports like Leona and Alistar for easy kills
  • Poke marksmen when they walk up to last-hit
  • Use Teleport to join fights after you recall
  • Keep Gaze of the Abyss ready against dives
  • Push waves with Molten Fissure to take plates
  • Spiraling Despair is extra strong in bot because enemies stand together
